description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about pets in the cabin.

files.description: A Confluence page in the customer-policies space for support agents about pets in the cabin, last updated between 2026-01-12 and 2026-05-15. It must contain these sentences word for word: "the pet fee goes back if the pet did not fly"; "any fare, Basic included". Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not mention battery, batteries, lithium, power bank, watt-hour.
